wstep: There is no recipe here for homemade douchi, Chinese fermented black soybeans, with ginger.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Douchi caused a Bacillus cereus outbreak in China that affected 139 people; the strains were isolated from vomit and from the unprepared douchi, and two of them produced the emetic toxin cereulide.
Bacillus spores may germinate and produce toxin if cooked rice, barley or other cereals are not cooled within 2 hours before inoculation.

akapity: JarAtlas rule (cautious): this guidance is written for cereals, and JarAtlas treats cooked soybeans with the same caution.
According to the BC Centre for Disease Control, shiokara-natto (salted natto) is made from fermented black soybeans inoculated with koji (Aspergillus oryzae).
That is a description of a process, not a tested home recipe for douchi.
JarAtlas has found no tested home procedure for making douchi from a checked source.
